This is the top_edge corridor.

adjusted_prescription: To best demonstrate commitment to the Top-edge corridor, the demonstration should start clearly from the position (0,0) and take a path along the top row toward the goal. This route must emphasize a safe, stable corridor that avoids oscillating between routes, even when fire hazards appear randomly in the center. If fire blocks part of the top row, the demo should show careful, safe detours that keep the agent close to the top corridor. The demonstration should also include descending safely along the final column to reach the goal, illustrating how to navigate around central fires without compromising the corridor choice. Showing this consistent preference for the Top-edge corridor under fire pressure will help train the policy to avoid mid-episode risky switches and reduce collisions with fire hazards.
